paragraphs: A Land Rover AJ200P engine rebuild starts from £3,600, regardless of which of the six models it's fitted to — the price tier is set by the engine, not the badge on the boot. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available.
Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.

cards.title: Rebuilding Your
cards.body: Most engine suppliers sell you a used engine of unknown history and hope it matches. We rebuild the engine your Land Rover already has instead — strip it down, pressure-test it, and replace every worn or damaged component with updated OEM parts. You get a near-new engine with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, without the compatibility risk of an unknown used unit. This is the option most AJ200P owners choose.

cards.title: Replacement
cards.body: If your existing engine is beyond economical repair, we also offer full engine replacement and fitting — sourced and fitted by our team, with the same 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

cards.title: Used
cards.body: In some cases, a matched low-mileage used engine is the right call — particularly if you need your car back on the road quickly and your existing engine's damage is extensive. We can source and fit these too, though most owners who ask about used engines end up choosing a rebuild once they understand the compatibility risk a used unit carries.

options.body: "Reconditioned" is the term many owners search for when they mean the same thing as a rebuild — a full strip-down, inspection, and replacement of worn parts rather than a straight swap. If that's what you're after, our rebuild service is exactly that.
"Refurbished" often describes the same process from a different angle — restoring your existing engine to full working condition rather than replacing it outright. Our rebuild covers this.

Some owners specifically search for a "remanufactured" engine, expecting a unit rebuilt to original specification with updated components. That's consistent with what our rebuild service delivers, regardless of which of the six AJ200P-equipped models you drive.

faqLeft.q: What is the Land Rover AJ200P engine?
faqLeft.a: The AJ200P is Land Rover's 2.0-litre turbocharged inline-four petrol engine, part of the Ingenium family. It's been in production since 2016 and is fitted across five Land Rover model lines.

faqLeft.q: Which Land Rover models use the AJ200P?
faqLeft.a: Defender (P300), Discovery (P300), Discovery Sport (P200/P250/P290), Range Rover Evoque (P200/P250), and Range Rover Velar (P250/P300).

faqLeft.q: What are the power outputs of the AJ200P?
faqLeft.a: The AJ200P is available in three outputs: P200 (200 hp), P250 (250 hp), and P300 (300 hp).

faqLeft.q: Does the AJ200P differ between Land Rover models?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The specific ancillaries, mounting, and ECU calibration differ by application, even though the base engine code is the same. We match by registration/VIN before confirming any rebuild or replacement.

faqLeft.q: Is an AJ200P from one Land Rover model compatible with another?
faqLeft.a: Not automatically. A Defender's AJ200P isn't a drop-in match for a Discovery Sport's unit — ancillaries, mounting, and ECU software all differ. We always confirm compatibility by registration/VIN.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover AJ200P engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,200, regardless of which model it's fitted to. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.
Yes. We work on AJ200P rebuilds across every model it's fitted to, replacing worn components as standard.

faqLeft.q: What are the known issues with the AJ200P?
faqLeft.a: Timing chain stretch is well-documented on petrol Ingenium engines, with chains known to fail at around 100,000 miles. VVT solenoid issues and higher-than-acceptable oil consumption have also been reported.

faqRight.q: What are the symptoms of AJ200P timing chain issues?
faqRight.a: Rattling noise on cold start (timing chain slack), fluctuation of revs when idling, engine warning light, poor running or misfires, and loss of power.

faqRight.q: Can you rebuild an AJ200P from a Defender?
faqRight.a: Yes. The AJ200P in the Defender (P300) is one of the applications we work on regularly.

faqRight.q: Can you rebuild an AJ200P from a Discovery Sport?
faqRight.a: Yes. The AJ200P in the Discovery Sport (P200/P250/P290) is one of the most common applications we see.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Land Rover AJ200P engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Land Rover if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an AJ200P engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your vehicle arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most AJ200P owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.
